description: 警戒水位值影響範圍 [flood] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 水利署災害緊急應變系統為平時或汛期值班應變的核心系統，更是許多相關防災系統的資料供應重要來源，透過系統與資通訊技術達成整備、監控、預警、通報、應變、決策六大任務，可作為防災應變人員之最佳資訊輔助工具，供水利署作為災害應變決策之參考。 水利防災中心為統計透過分析水位變化，推估可能受影響的範圍，以利評估相對應防汛作為，產製周期需俟降雨預報進行... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
